_notes: Randy's tracked charter captains (v23.38, 2026-08-12 update). Randy's directive (2026-08-12): 'I'm more interested in charter boats that take PEOPLE out fishing for rec-sized tuna, not commercial giant-hunters. See if you can round some more up.' Ten new operations added this pass (RI/CT/NY/MA), all vetted against public OTW reports or captains' own recent 2025-2026 content. All entries target `bluefin_recreational` (27-73" fork length) and/or yellowfin/bigeye. The 🎣 Captains map layer is intentionally hidden (v23.37 Randy directive) — this data is now used ONLY for the model's captainDwellBoost signal + YouTube chatter cross-reference. To add a MMSI: look up the boat on marinetraffic.com or vesselfinder.com, copy the 9-digit MMSI, drop it in this file's `mmsi` field. To add a captain: append a new entry with `youtube_channel_id` (24-char UC…) linking back to data/youtube_channels.json so the Fleet Chatter widget can cross-reference. Two of the new entries have verified YouTube channels — the rest publish primarily to Instagram (captured in `instagram_handle`) and would need a different ingestion path.
